Card Q&A.a: No. This inherited effect only allows you to gain 1 memory per turn, no matter how many Digimon are deleted.
Card Q&A.q: If 2 or more of my other Digimon are deleted at the same time, can I gain 2 memory?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon is deleted, gain 1 memory.
